arguments.code:
token_res=apis.spotify.login(username='andrew_brow@gmail.com', password='kWuKkrH')
access_token=token_res['access_token']

# get playlists and song ids
all_playlists=[]
pi=0
while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=pi, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(page)
    pi+=1

all_song_ids=set()
for p in all_playlists:
    pl=apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=p['playlist_id'], access_token=access_token)
    for s in pl.get('songs',[]):
        all_song_ids.add(s['id'])

reggae_song_ids=[]
reggae_artists_by_id={}  # artist_id -> name

for sid in sorted(all_song_ids):
    s=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    genre=s.get('genre')
    if isinstance(genre,str) and genre.lower()=='reggae':
        reggae_song_ids.append(sid)
        for a in s.get('artists',[]):
            aid=a.get('id')
            aname=a.get('name')
            if aid is not None:
                reggae_artists_by_id[aid]=aname

print('total_song_ids', len(all_song_ids))
print('reggae_song_ids_count', len(reggae_song_ids))
print('reggae_song_ids_sample', reggae_song_ids[:20])
print('unique_reggae_artists', len(reggae_artists_by_id))
# show a few artist ids/names
items=list(reggae_artists_by_id.items())
print('artists_sample', [(aid,reggae_artists_by_id[aid]) for aid,_ in items[:20]])
